description: This file defines the DirectorySearch utility class used for locating directories such as source directories, module roots, repo roots, and template directories within an Android development project. It includes methods for discovering project structure elements like source folders, exclude directories, and repository or module roots based on specific project files such as '.repo' and 'Android.mk'.

classes.name: DirectorySearch
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for finding directory structures within an Android project's repository, including source dirs, module roots, repo roots, exclude dirs, and template directories.

methods.name: getRepoRoot
methods.description: Returns the previously initialized repository root directory.

methods.name: findAndInitRepoRoot
methods.description: Recursively searches parent directories to locate the repository root marked by a '.repo' directory, and initializes the static variable 'repoRoot'.

methods.name: findModuleRoot
methods.description: Ascends parent directories from a given path to find the Android.mk file indicating the module root.

methods.name: findSourceDirs
methods.description: Recursively searches a directory tree to locate source directories, typically 'src' or 'java', accounting for nested structures.

methods.name: findExcludeDirs
methods.description: Finds directories within a 'res' folder that match exclusion patterns, such as language-specific 'values-..' folders.

methods.name: findTemplateDir
methods.description: Locates the directory containing templates for IDE code generation, using cached paths or based on the current execution context.
